name: Ahead of It
version: v3 · 2026-11-09 · the three apps are one

persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Wanjiru, 34, in Nairobi. You look after the family papers for yourself and your mother, Mama Njeri, who is 70. Every year something is missed: a late fee on the car insurance, a forgotten KRA deadline. Today you put every important date in one place, so nothing surprises the family again.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains an app called Ahead of It, what it is for and how to use it.
First, the problem. Every home has dates that cost money if you forget them. Insurance that must be renewed. A tax that must be paid. A licence that runs out. The dog's vaccine.
They come once a year, at different times, and they all live in one person's head. And heads forget.
Ahead of It holds those dates for you. It shows what is coming next, and what it costs you to miss each one.
Who uses it? The person who carries the household. The app was made in America, so some ready-made items are American. You can ignore those, and add your own with the orange plus button.

Some ready-made items will work for you, like the income tax return or car insurance. For anything else, like school fees, land rates or a pet's vaccine, add your own. Think of your own family's dates too.
Money shows dollars. Think in shillings if it helps.
Everything stays on this phone. There is no bank login, and nothing is sent to anyone.
When you first open it, a welcome card offers a tour. Watch it, or tap skip the tour. Then it asks how you want to start: keep the examples to play with, or start fresh with your own.

lines.t: At the top is the name, Ahead of It, and a small word that says all clear, or how many things are overdue.

This one app holds three lists. Household, church, and nonprofit. You choose which one it is for, and you can turn a second one on beside it. Nothing you have added is ever taken away when you switch a list off.

lines: The main page is called Next. It has four groups: Overdue, Do something now, Next 90 days, and Later. Each line shows a name, how many days away it is, and a colour.
The colours matter. Red means missing it costs real money. Yellow means a hassle. Green means no big deal.

lines.t: To add the common things quickly, tap the gold button, Quick setup. When the list is empty, it sits inside the big welcome card. Tick what your house has, fix the date on that line, and tap Save my list at the bottom.
To add something of your own, tap the orange button with the plus sign.

lines: A form opens. Write What it is. Choose the Next due date, and how often it Repeats. Choose how bad it is if you miss it. Write who else needs to know, the amount, and where the papers are kept. Then tap Save.
To change an item, tap its name.
When a bill is paid, tap done, with a tick, on its line. The item moves to its next date, so it is ready for next year.

lines.t: Near the top of Next is the money strip. Put amounts on your bills, and it adds up what is due this month and what is paid.

lines: The Year tab shows twelve months on one page, and the Library holds sixty-five ready-made items across the three lists — twenty-three of them for a household.
To start again with an empty list, scroll to the very bottom and tap Start fresh, erase this app's data. It asks you twice.
That is all. Put in your real dates, see what is coming, and mark them done when they are paid.
In the test, you will help a Kenyan family put their dates in order. Take your time. If something is confusing, say so. That is exactly what we want to find.

challenge.intro: Now you are Wanjiru in Nairobi, sorting out the family's dates. The app is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Ahead of It with the normal link (not the 🧪 test copy). If a welcome card offers a tour, tap 'skip the tour'. If it then asks 'How do you want to start?', tap '✨ Start fresh with my own'. If a card headed 'What am I doing here?' is in the way, tap 'Got it — let's go ›'. Then scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app's data' → OK → OK (if it says 'There is nothing saved in this app yet', just tap OK). The page now says 'Everything that costs you if you forget it — on one calm page.' and asks which list it is for. Leave it on 🏠 Household. (Verified 9 Nov against the joined app: all five checks false after this.)

tasks.text: Wanjiru must file her income tax return with KRA by 30 June every year. If she misses it, there is a penalty. Add it from the app's ready-made list and set the date to 30 June.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aheadofit_v1')||localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}function car(i){var n=L(i.n);return /(car|auto|vehicle|motor)/.test(n)&&/insur/.test(n)}return it.some(function(i){var n=L(i.n);return /(tax|kra)/.test(n)&&/(return|kra)/.test(n)&&MD(i.due)==='06-30'});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: The gold ⚡ Quick setup button (or the 📚 Library tab) has a ready-made 'Income tax return' item. Tick it, change its date to 30 June, and save.

tasks.text: The car insurance renews on 1 March and costs KES 18,500. If it is missed, the family drives with no insurance, and that costs real money. Put it on the list with the right date, the amount, and how bad it is to miss.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aheadofit_v1')||localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}function car(i){var n=L(i.n);return /(car|auto|vehicle|motor)/.test(n)&&/insur/.test(n)}return it.some(function(i){return car(i)&&MD(i.due)==='03-01'&&Math.abs(N(i.amt)-18500)<0.01&&i.sev==='h'});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Find or add the car insurance item, then tap its name. Check the Next due date (1 March), type 18500 as the Amount, and choose 🔴 Costs real money.

tasks.text: Simba the dog needs his rabies vaccine every year on 20 May. Wanjiru's brother Kamau must be told about it.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aheadofit_v1')||localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}function car(i){var n=L(i.n);return /(car|auto|vehicle|motor)/.test(n)&&/insur/.test(n)}return it.some(function(i){return /(dog|rabies|vaccin|simba)/.test(L(i.n))&&MD(i.due)==='05-20'&&/kamau/.test(L(i.who))});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add it (orange ＋ or the ready-made dog item), set the date to 20 May, and put Kamau in 'Who else needs to know'.

tasks.text: The car insurance papers are kept in the blue folder in the kitchen drawer. Write that down so another person could find them.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aheadofit_v1')||localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}function car(i){var n=L(i.n);return /(car|auto|vehicle|motor)/.test(n)&&/insur/.test(n)}return it.some(function(i){var w=L([i.where,i.ref,i.contact].join(' '));return car(i)&&/blue/.test(w)&&/folder/.test(w)});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Tap the car insurance item's name. There is a box called 'Where the papers / login are'.

tasks.text: The county land rates for Mama Njeri's plot are KES 4,500 a year, and Wanjiru paid them today. Put them on the list and mark them as paid, so they move on to next time.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aheadofit_v1')||localStorage.getItem('ahead_v1')||'{}')||{};var it=Array.isArray(d.items)?d.items:[];function L(x){return String(x==null?'':x).toLowerCase()}function N(x){var s=String(x==null?'':x).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return s?parseFloat(s):NaN}function MD(x){return String(x||'').slice(5,10)}function car(i){var n=L(i.n);return /(car|auto|vehicle|motor)/.test(n)&&/insur/.test(n)}return it.some(function(i){if(!/(rate|land|property)/.test(L(i.n)))return false;var paid=(i.pay||[]).some(function(p){return Math.abs(N(p.amt)-4500)<0.01});return (i.hist||[]).length>=1&&(paid||Math.abs(N(i.amt)-4500)<0.01)});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Add 'Land rates' with the orange ＋, type 4500 as the amount (and make sure it repeats every year, not 'Once'). Then tap 'done ✓' on its line.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: keeps all the important dates that cost money if you miss them in one place
shows what is coming next and how bad it is to miss each one
mark it done when paid and it moves to the next date

daily.task: Add or update a date in Ahead of It — a bill, a renewal or a birthday (made-up is fine).

explore.name: 📅 Next (tab 1)
explore.find: Open Ahead of It. You start here.
explore.try: Look at Overdue, Do something now, Next 90 days and Later. Tap step ✓ on one item and done ✓ on another.

explore.name: 💰 The money strip
explore.try: Tap 💰 and type a balance (then try letters). Open 📋 This month’s list and Close.

explore.name: 🏠⛪💼 The three lists
explore.find: The 📚 Library tab — “Showing the list for:” at the top.
explore.try: Turn ⛪ Church on beside 🏠 Household and watch five more groups appear. Add one church item. Turn Church off again — your item must stay on Next. Then try turning the last list off.

explore.name: ✏️ One item
explore.find: Tap the name of any item.
explore.try: Change every box. 📎 Add a photo if you like. Save. Then Cancel on another, and Delete one.

explore.name: ➕ Add your own · ⚡ Setup list
explore.try: Add your own thing with a long name. In the Setup list tick three things, change a date, Save my list.

explore.name: 🗓 Year (tab 2)
explore.try: Look at the twelve months. Tap 🖨 Print and 📅 calendar — you can cancel both.

explore.name: 📚 Library (tab 3)
explore.try: Add two things. Tap one that already says “added” and see what it says.

explore.name: 🤝 Hand-off (tab 4)
explore.try: Tap 📋 Copy and 🖨 Print (cancel). ⬇ Save a backup. Tick One Thing. Type the household and the person to tell.

explore.name: ⚙️ Top buttons
explore.find: The small buttons at the very top.
explore.try: Tap ⓘ (captions on and off), 🎨 Look and Aa Size, and read the small pill that says “all clear” or how many are overdue. Put each one back after.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa text size, 🎤 Tell it, ✨ Ask an AI about this screen, 🌉 More from Daraja, ? What am I doing here?, 🤖 Which AI do you use?, 🎬 Take the tour again, 👪 My Circle. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” and “See it as a new user” for the very end.
